## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

---

### 1. 收入同比增长计算

**数据来源**：`press_release.txt`（"Three Months Ended June 30" 分部收入表）与 `metrics.txt`

| 项目 | FY26 Q4（截至2026/6/30） | FY25 Q4（截至2025/6/30） |
|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | **$39,306 百万** | **$29,878 百万** |

**计算过程**：
- 同比增长额 = $39,306M − $29,878M = **$9,428M**
- 同比增长率 = $9,428M ÷ $29,878M = **31.6%**，四舍五入为 **32%**（GAAP 口径）
- 恒定汇率口径（按 press_release.txt 披露的 Constant Currency Impact = $80M）：($39,306M − $80M − $29,878M) ÷ $29,878M ≈ **31%**

**结论**：Intelligent Cloud 收入同比增长 **32%（GAAP）/ 31%（恒定汇率）**。

---

### 2. 管理层归因（电话会原话引用）

**来源**：`transcript.txt`，Amy Hood 在 FY26 Q4 财报电话会上对 Intelligent Cloud 分部的评论（位置约 24808–25200 字符）。

> *"Next, the Intelligent Cloud segment. Revenue was $39.3 billion and grew 32% and 31% in constant currency."*

> *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. **Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity.** Revenue growth was ahead of expectations **driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity.** That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized. Results also benefited from **stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value.**"*

> *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by **renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts.**"*

**归因因素汇总**：
1. **Azure 客户持续供不应求**（"Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity"）
2. **CPU/GPU 效率提升**（"efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet"）
3. **流程改进使新产能更早交付并变现**（"process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity … quickly monetized"）
4. **GitHub Copilot 消费超预期**（"stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change"）
5. **本地服务器续签合同中当期确认收入占比提高**（"renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts"）

---

### 3. 已发生事实 vs 前瞻性表述的区分

| 编号 | 归因表述 | 性质 | 区分依据 |
|---|---|---|---|
| ① | "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity" | **已发生事实** | 使用现在时态 "continues"，是对 Q4 季度内实际供需状态的描述，且该季度 Azure 增长 43% 已实际兑现 |
| ② | "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet" | **已发生事实** | "was ahead of expectations" 是对已报告季度业绩的事后评价；效率提升是已实现的运营成果 |
| ③ | "process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity … quickly monetized" | **已发生事实** | "was quickly monetized" 使用过去时态，表明产能已在 Q4 内交付并变现，属于已完成事件 |
| ④ | "stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change" | **已发生事实** | "June business model change" 是已实施的政策变更，"stronger-than-expected consumption" 是对该季度实际消费数据的描述 |
| ⑤ | "renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts" | **已发生事实** | 描述的是 Q4 已完成的续签合同结构，属于已实现的会计结果 |

**前瞻性表述**（在同一段电话会中但属于未来指引，需注意区分）：

> *"we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply. Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate."*

> *"For Intelligent Cloud, we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%. In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency…"*

- "we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate" — **前瞻性表述**：关键词 "expect" 指向 FY27 上半年的未来增长预期，并非已发生。
- "we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion" — **前瞻性表述**：明确的未来季度指引（FY27 Q1）。

**核心区分逻辑**：已发生事实均使用过去时态（"was", "grew", "was quickly monetized"）或对已完成季度业绩的回顾性评价；前瞻性表述使用 "expect / anticipate / continue to expect" 等措辞，指向尚未发生的未来期间业绩。
